component.name: Feedstr
component.summary: Mildly improved reading for RSS and more

description.p: A feed reader, written in Rust, that syncs feeds via the decentralized protocol Nostr.

Follow RSS and Atom feeds, Gemini feeds, YouTube channels, Nostr long-form posts (NIP-23) and websites on Nostr (nsites). Read and favorite state, subscriptions and settings sync between your devices, encrypted, through Nostr relays. Feeds can be fetched through Tor or I2P.
Sync is now optional on desktop and Android: use Feedstr as a plain feed reader on one device, and turn on sync later if you want it.
Fixes a hang when reopening the app quickly on Android, and deleted data coming back after syncing.
